caption: The eight threads of add<<<2, 4>>> in launch order. threadIdx restarts at 0 in each block, so block 1 thread 1 is global tid 5 — the thread that computes C[5] = 11 + 3 = 14.

spec.title: add<<<2, 4>>>: tid = block × 4 + thread
spec.aria: Two blocks of four threads: block 0 holds global indices 0 to 3 and block 1 holds 4 to 7, with block 1 thread 1 at index 5 computing C[5] = 14.
